module: Cisco Aironet 1562 e/i/d/ps, 2802 e/i and 3802 e/i/p Wireless LAN Access Points
caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 3. This module contains the embedded module 'ACT2Lite Cryptographic Module' validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #3637 operating in FIPS mode
description: Cisco Aironet Series Wireless Access Points provide highly secure and reliable wireless connections for both indoor and outdoor environments.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #2073 and #2074, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #2073 and #2074, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 192 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (RSA key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 128 bits of encryption strength)
hardware_versions: 1562e, 1562i, 1562d, 1562ps, 2802e, 2802i, 3802e, 3802i, 3802p with FIPS Kit: AIRLAP-FIPSKIT=, VERSION B0

approved.note: AES Cert. #5682; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength

other_text: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #2073 and #2074, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #2073 and #2074, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 192 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (RSA key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 128 bits of encryption strength)
